mapper.select: select id from p_point_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and business_type='TTS_SEGMENT' and business_id=#{businessId} and reservation_no=1

select rate_version_id rateVersionId,unit_price_cent unitPriceCent,tts_application_id applicationId from p_point_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and tts_request_key=#{requestKey} and business_type='TTS_SEGMENT' and billing_item='TTS_CHARACTER' order by id limit 1 for update
mapper.sql: id,version_no versionNo,generation_action_cent generationActionCent, tts_character_cent ttsCharacterCent,storage_byte_cent storageByteCent,effective_at effectiveAt,created_at createdAt

id,account_id accountId,business_type businessType,business_id businessId, reservation_no reservationNo,billing_item billingItem,measured_units measuredUnits,unit_price_cent unitPriceCent, rate_version_id rateVersionId,reserved_cent reservedCent,settled_cent settledCent,state,created_at createdAt
mapper.select: select from p_point_rate_version where effective_at <= utc_timestamp(3) order by effective_at desc,version_no desc limit 1
select from p_point_rate_version order by version_no desc limit 1 for update
select from p_point_rate_version order by version_no desc limit 50
select granted_cent grantedCent,used_cent usedCent,reserved_cent reservedCent from p_point_balance where account_id=#{accountId} for update
mapper.update: update p_point_balance set reserved_cent=reserved_cent+#{amountCent},revision=revision+1, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and granted_cent-used_cent-reserved_cent >= #{amountCent}

update p_point_balance set reserved_cent=reserved_cent-#{reservedCent}, used_cent=used_cent+#{settledCent},revision=revision+1,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and reserved_cent >= #{reservedCent} and used_cent+#{settledCent} <= granted_cent
update p_point_balance set granted_cent=granted_cent+#{amountCent},revision=revision+1, updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where account_id=#{accountId} and granted_cent <= 9223372036854775807-#{amountCent}
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{accountId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
select from p_point_reservation where account_id=#{accountId} and business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and reservation_no=#{reservationNo} for update
select from p_point_reservation where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update p_point_reservation set state=#{state},settled_cent=#{settledCent}, settled_at=case when #{state}='SETTLED' then utc_timestamp(3) else settled_at end, released_at=case when #{state}='RELEASED' then utc_timestamp(3) else released_at end,updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state=#{fromState}
update p_point_reservation set state='REVIEW_REQUIRED',updated_at=utc_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: select delta_granted_cent amountCent,reason from p_point_entry where account_id=#{accountId} and event_key=#{eventKey}
